about.title: Institut Supérieur de Commerce de Mbujimayi
about.subtitle: For over 30 years, ISC Mbujimayi has trained the professionals who shape the economy of Kasaï-Oriental and the Democratic Republic of Congo.
about.mission_p1: The Institut Supérieur de Commerce de Mbujimayi (ISC Mbujimayi) is a public higher education institution located in Mbujimayi, the capital of Kasaï-Oriental province, in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
about.mission_p2: Our mission is to train highly qualified professionals in the fields of commerce, management, IT and finance, capable of actively contributing to the socio-economic development of the country.
about.mission_p3: Through innovative pedagogy and strategic partnerships, we provide our students with the tools needed to succeed in an ever-changing professional world.
about.value_excellence_desc: We train competent professionals adapted to the economic realities of the DRC and the world.
about.value_innovation_desc: Our modern teaching methods combine theory and practice for optimal learning.
about.value_community_desc: A dynamic student community, supported by an experienced and dedicated faculty.
about.value_recognition_desc: Institution accredited by the Government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, issuing recognized diplomas.
